Ingredients (11)

  • 0.25 tsp pepper 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
  • 0.25 tsp cayenne pepper 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
  • 0.75 lbs elbow macaroni 1 pound elbow macaroni
  • 0.25 cups flour 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
  • 5 oz gruyere 2 cups (about 8 ounces) grated Gruyere
  • 1.25 tsp kosher salt 2 teaspoons kosher salt
  • 0.25 tsp nutmeg 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
  • 5 tbsp butter 8 tablespoons (1 stick) unsalted butter, plus more for dish
  • 4 slices bread 6 slices white bread
  • 12 oz cheddar cheese 4 1/2 cups (about 18 ounces) grated white cheddar cheese
  • 3.75 cups milk 5 1/2 cups whole milk

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Butter a 3-quart casserole dish; set aside.
  2. Step 2
    Place bread pieces in a medium bowl. In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons butter.
  3. Step 3
    Pour butter into the bowl with bread, and toss. Set the breadcrumbs aside. In a medium saucepan set over medium heat, heat milk. Melt remaining 6 tablespoons butter in a high-sided skillet over medium heat. When butter bubbles, add flour. Cook, stirring, 1 minute.Slowly pour hot milk into flour-butter mixture while whisking. Continue cooking, whisking constantly, until the mixture bubbles and becomes thick.
  4. Step 4
    Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in salt, nutmeg, black pepper, cayenne pepper, 3 cups cheddar, and 1 1/2 cups Gruyere. Set cheese sauce aside.Fill a large saucepan with water. Bring to a boil.
  5. Step 5
    Add macaroni; cook 2 to 3 fewer minutes than manufacturers directions, until outside of pasta is cooked and inside is underdone. (Different brands of macaroni cook at different rates; be sure to read the instructions.)
  6. Step 6
    Transfer the macaroni to a colander, rinse under cold running water, and drain well. Stir macaroni into the reserved cheese sauce.
  7. Step 7
    Pour the mixture into the prepared casserole dish.
  8. Step 8
    Sprinkle remaining 1 1/2 cups cheddar and 1/2 cup Gruyere; scatter breadcrumbs over the top.
  9. Step 9
    Bake until browned on top, about 30 minutes.
  10. Step 10
    Transfer dish to a wire rack to cool for 5 minutes; serve.

Ingredients (9)

  • 0.75 cups bread crumbs 1⁄2 cup fresh bread crumbs
  • 11 tbsp butter 8 tbsp. butter
  • 0.75 tsp cayenne pepper 1⁄2 tsp. cayenne pepper
  • 8 tbsp flour 6 tbsp. flour
  • 0.75 cups heavy cream 1⁄2 cup heavy cream
  • 1.25 lbs short macaroni 1 lb. short macaroni, cooked
  • 8 salt and pepper Salt and freshly ground white pepper
  • 5.25 cups sharp cheddar 4 cups grated sharp cheddar
  • 5 cups milk 3 3⁄4 cups hot whole milk

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat oven to 35
  2. Step 2
    Melt 6 tbsp. butter in a medium saucepan over low heat.
  3. Step 3
    Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, for about 4 minutes.Stir in cayenne and season to taste with salt and pepper.
  4. Step 4
    Whisk in hot milk, 1/2 cup at a time, and cook, stirring, until sauce thickens. Reduce heat to low and stir in 2 cups of cheese. Cook, stirring, until cheese melts, about 2 minutes.
  5. Step 5
    Combine pasta and sauce in a large bowl, and season with salt.
  6. Step 6
    Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese over the bottom of a buttered 8" 11" baking dish.
  7. Step 7
    Place one-third of the pasta in the baking dish, top with 1/2 cup of cheese, then repeat, layering pasta and cheese, ending with cheese, making three layers in all.
  8. Step 8
    Pour cream over assembled macaroni and cheese. Melt remaining butter in a skillet.
  9. Step 9
    Add bread crumbs, coat with melted butter, and sprinkle over macaroni and cheese.
  10. Step 10
    Bake until crust is golden, about 30 minutes. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before serving.

Ingredients (17)

  • 4 lbs equivalent amount of a ground beef/bulk sausage mix 1 lb ground beef or equivalent amount of a ground beef/bulk Italian sausage mix; hall portion
  • 0.75 cups ricotta 1/2 cup ricotta
  • 1.3 pinch oregano pinch of oregano
  • 1.3 pinch basil pinch of basil
  • 1.3 tbs parmesan cheese 1 Tbs grated Parmesan cheese
  • 35 oz pasta sauce 1 - 26 oz jar of pasta sauce
  • 1 can pizza sauce 1 can pizza sauce
  • 0.25 tsp pepper flakes 1/8 - 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes
  • 1 pepperoni Pepperoni slices (I used 1/2 of a package of Hormel brand)
  • 2.75 cups mozzarella 2 cups shredded mozzarella
  • 0.75 cups aged provolone 1/2 cup shredded aged Provolone
  • 8 herbed parmesan drop biscuits Herbed Parmesan Drop Biscuits
  • 8 additional parmesan cheese Additional Parmesan cheese for topping
  • 3 cups baking mix 2 1/4 cup baking mix (like Bisquick or Jiffy)
  • 1.25 tsp seasoning 1 tsp Italian seasoning
  • 1 cup milk 2/3 cup milk
  • 1 or -or-

Steps (9)

  1. Step 1
    Brown ground beef in skillet; drain fat.
  2. Step 2
    Mix in pasta or pizza sauce and pepper flakes; set aside.
  3. Step 3
    Mix ricotta cheese with the herbs and Parmesan in a separate bowl; set aside.
  4. Step 4
    Mix the dry ingredients for the biscuits.
  5. Step 5
    Add milk and stir until combined.
  6. Step 6
    Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a 13 x 9 pan with non-stick spray. Drop biscuit dough by teaspoons in the bottom of pan, spacing evenly. It's OK if there is space between the dough--it will expand as it's cooked. Top with ground beef mixture and dot with the ricotta cheese mixture.
  7. Step 7
    Bake at 375 for about 20 min or until biscuits are puffed and beginning to get golden brown.
  8. Step 8
    Top with mozzarella and provolone cheeses and distribute pepperoni slices evenly over top, increase oven temperature to 425 degrees. Return to oven and bake until cheeses are melted and beginning to bubble. This should take about 10 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before slicing and serving. May be topped with the additional Parmesan cheese.

Ingredients (15)

  • 2 small avocado 1 small Avocado (chopped)
  • 1 tsp pepper ½ tsp black pepper
  • 30 oz black beans 1 (15oz) can of black beans (I like the low sodium version)
  • 20 oz canned tomatoes 1 (10oz) can of tomatoes with green chilis
  • 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp chili powder
  • 2 cups quinoa 1 cup cooked quinoa
  • 1 tsp cumin ½ tsp cumin
  • 20 oz verde enchilada sauce 1 (10oz) can of verde enchilada sauce
  • 4 tbsp cilantro fresh cilantro (2Tbsp and 2 tsp separated)
  • 8 green onion tops green onion tops (chopped)
  • 2 roma tomato 1 Roma tomato (chopped)
  • 8 salt salt to taste
  • 4 cups cheese 2 cups of shredded cheese (my favorite is the Kraft Mexican 4 cheese blend and one bag equals two cups!)
  • 2 chicken breast 1 boneless skinless chicken breast (boiled and shredded)
  • 30 oz corn 1 (15oz) can of sweet corn (you are only going to use half of the can)

Steps (4)

  1. Step 1
    To get started, heat your oven to 350 and prepare an 8x8 baking dish. Cook the quinoa according to the instructions. If you haven't already, boil and shred your chicken breast.In a medium sized mixing bowl add 2 Tbsp cilantro, 1 cup shredded cheese, quinoa, tomatoes with chilis, black beans, half of the can of sweet corn, verde enchilada sauce, cumin, chili powder, white pepper, black pepper, and salt to taste.
  2. Step 2
    Mix everything well, and then pour into the 8 x8 baking dish. Cover with the last cup of cheese and then bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
  3. Step 3
    Remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Then top with chopped Roma tomato, chopped avocado, green onion tops, and remaining 2 tsp of cilantro.
  4. Step 4
    Serve immediately.

Ingredients (17)

  • 4 bay leaf 1 bay leaf
  • 2 tsp peppercorns 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns
  • 4 tbsp butter 1 tablespoon butter
  • 4 cups chicken stock 1 cup chicken stock
  • 8 tsp cornstarch 2 teaspoons cornstarch dissolved in 1 Tbs water
  • 4 tsp chives 1 teaspoon dried chives
  • 4 tsp tarragon 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
  • 2 cups greek 1/2 cup Greek or plain yogurt
  • 4 tbsp horseradish 1 tablespoon horseradish
  • 4 tsp lemon juice 1 teaspoon lemon juice
  • 12 tbsp milk 3 tablespoons milk
  • 4 tbsp olive oil 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 4 onion 1 onion, chopped
  • 8 medium potatoes 2 mediums potatoes
  • 16 oz salmon 4 ounces smoked salmon, either wet or dry smoked
  • 32 oz savoy cabbage 8 ounces Savoy cabbage, sliced
  • 2 cups white wine 1/2 cup white wine

Steps (14)

  1. Step 1
    Peel potatoes and cut into chunks
  2. Step 2
    Cook in boiling, salted water until tender, app. 15 minutes
  3. Step 3
    Drain potatoes, add butter, horseradish and 2 tbs milk to potatoes, mash, adding a bit more milk if needed
  4. Step 4
    Put fresh salmon in a medium skillet, add water to almost cover, lemon juice, bay leaf and peppercorns. Cover and poach until done, 12 - 15 minutes. It should be opaque and flake easily with a fork.
  5. Step 5
    Remove salmon and cut into large chunks
  6. Step 6
    Roughly chop the smoked salmon
  7. Step 7
    Saut onion in oil until tender
  8. Step 8
    Add cabbage and saut, stirring 2 - 3 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Add white wine, chicken stock, herbs, cover and simmer 10 minutes
  10. Step 10
    Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to cabbage, stirring until thickened
  11. Step 11
    Remove from heat and add yogurt and stir well to combine.
  12. Step 12
    Add both salmons to cabbage and stir gently.Spoon into a baking dish
  13. Step 13
    Top with potatoes
  14. Step 14
    Bake, 400F (200C) for 15 minutes or until the top starts to brown.

Ingredients (18)

  • 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1 garlic bulb 1 whole garlic bulb
  • 4 lbs beef rib steak 1 pound Boneless Beef Rib Steak –; hall portion
  • 1 tsp worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
  • 1 tbsp jack daniels mustard 1/2 tablespoon Jack Daniels Mustard (or other spicy deli or Dijon mustard)<
  • 0.5 tsp pepper flakes 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
  • 0.25 cups rose syrah wine 1/4 cup Rose Syrah Wine
  • 3 roasted pepper sections 3 roasted red pepper sections (they make great varieties of different peppers in j
  • 0.5 cups marscapone cheese 1/2 cup Marscapone cheese
  • 2 tsp horseradish 2 teaspoons horseradish
  • 4 cloves roasted garlic 4 cloves of roasted garlic
  • 1 tbsp basil 1/2 tablespoon tsp. dried basil or 1 fresh
  • 0.5 tsp oregano 1/2 teaspoon tsp. dried oregano or 1 fresh (fresh oregano is strong so you may want to taste
  • 2 tsp lemon juice 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice
  • 2 pinch of salt 2 pinchs of salt
  • 2 pinch of pepper 2 pinchs of pepper
  • 1 loaf bread 1 loaf of store bought French bread
  • 1 small or) 1 small or ½ of a large sweet onion (Vidalia if you can get it)

Steps (20)

  1. Step 1
    Drizzle 1 tbsp. of olive oil over garlic bulb and wrap in aluminum foil.
  2. Step 2
    Roast on a cookie sheet in oven at 400 for approximately 40 minutes.
  3. Step 3
    Remove and let cool to touch.
  4. Step 4
    While garlic is roasting marinate steak with next 4 ingredients in a ziplock bag.
  5. Step 5
    Toss to coat and let sit while you slice vegetables.
  6. Step 6
    Heat olive oil in skillet on medium heat.
  7. Step 7
    Slice onion and peppers in 3 inch strips.
  8. Step 8
    Add onion to hot pan and saut until onions get slightly browned and caramelized for about 20 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Toss peppers in and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes.
  10. Step 10
    While onions and peppers are cooking place steak on a roasting pan and broil in oven or grill for approximately 5 to 10 minutes per side. Be careful as this steak will be tough if cooked to well done. And it will continue to cook when removed from the heat so under cook it a little to account for this process.
  11. Step 11
    Remove from heat and let rest before cutting.
  12. Step 12
    In a food processor combine marscapone, horseradish, and squeeze out 4 of the roasted garlic cloves. (Store the rest of the bulb in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week)
  13. Step 13
    Pulse a few times to blend.
  14. Step 14
    Add next 6 ingredients and mix well.
  15. Step 15
    Slice French Bread into inch rounds and heat in oven or on grill (grilled bread takes on a very unique sweet smoky flavor) until lightly toasted.
  16. Step 16
    Cut steak into 1/8 to inch strips.
  17. Step 17
    Smooth sauce over each warm piece of bread.
  18. Step 18
    Top with steak and the onion pepper mixture.
  19. Step 19
    These are appetizer bites but you could transform this into a hungry mans meal by using a large baguette or sub roll.
  20. Step 20
    Any other variations, suggestions, or commentsplease share!

Ingredients (14)

  • 0.25 cups basil leaves in strips 1/4 cup basil leaves in strips
  • 1 tbsp butter 2 tablespoons butter
  • 1 cup canned tomatoes 1 1/2 cups canned tomatoes with their juice (one 16- ounce can)
  • 1.3 medium eggplants 2 mediums eggplants
  • 1 garlic cloves 2 garlic cloves chopped
  • 1 tbsp olive oil 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 0.7 large onion 1 large onion, chopped
  • 0.5 cups parmesan cheese 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
  • 0.25 cups parsley 1/4 cup chopped parsley
  • 0.25 tsp pepper 1/2 teaspoon Pepper
  • 0.5 tsp salt 3/4 teaspoon salt
  • 5 oz mozzarella 8 ounces shredded mozzarella
  • 0.25 lbs ziti 1/2 pound ziti
  • 1.3 large zucchini 2 large zucchini

Steps (12)

  1. Step 1
    Peel the eggplants.
  2. Step 2
    Cut into 1/8-inch-thick slices, sprinkle with salt and put in a colander to drain. Pat dry. Slice the zucchini.
  3. Step 3
    In a skillet, heat 1/4 cup olive oil and fry the eggplant and zucchini until browned on both sides. Take them out of the pan and drain on paper towels.Lowfat Variation: spray eggplant and zucchini with olive oil and bake at 450F until brown. about 15 mins.
  4. Step 4
    Cook the ziti in boiling salted water.
  5. Step 5
    Drain and set aside.
  6. Step 6
    In a saucepan, heat the remaining 1/4 cup oil.
  7. Step 7
    Add the onion and cook until translucent.
  8. Step 8
    Add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Add the tomatoes, basil, parsley, salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
  10. Step 10
    Pour into the bowl with the drained ziti.
  11. Step 11
    Rub two shallow baking pans with olive oil. In the first pan, put 1/4 of the ziti, then 1/4 of the eggplant and zucchini. Dot with butter, add 1/4 of the mozzarella and then 1/4 of the Parmesan. Repeat the layers in that pan and do the same in the second pan.
  12. Step 12
    Bake one of the pans in a 350-degree oven for 30 minutes until the top is brown and crusty. Cover the other pan tightly with aluminum foil and freeze. Defrost before baking. Each pan will make 4 to 6 servings.

But if youre using a penne or something denser youll need more time for the pasta.Pull the chicken out and top with mozzarella cheese, put back into the oven to melt the cheese.Plate the pasta first, topped with chicken and the cover with sauce. Ingredients (9)

  • 2 lbs asparagus 1 lb medium thickness asparagus woody ends trimmed
  • 12 tbsp butter 6 Tbsp butter diced into small cubes
  • 6 tbsp chicken broth 3 Tbsp dry white wine or chicken broth
  • 4 tbsp fresh parsley 2 Tbsp chopped fresh parsley
  • 8 tsp garlic 4 tsp minced garlic
  • 3 tbsp lemon juice 1 1/2 Tbsp fresh lemon juice
  • 4 tsp lemon zest 2 tsp lemon zest
  • 8 salt and pepper Salt and freshly ground black pepper
  • 4 lbs shrimp 1 1/2 lbs large (21/25) shrimp peeled and deveined*; hall portion

Steps (7)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat a grill to medium-high heat (about 400 - 425 degrees).
  2. Step 2
    Cut 4 sheets of 14 by 12-inch heavy duty aluminum foil then lay each piece separately on countertop.
  3. Step 3
    Divide shrimp among packets near center then place asparagus to one side of the shrimp (going the long direction of the foil).
  4. Step 4
    Pour 1/2 Tbsp white wine over each.
  5. Step 5
    Sprinkle over garlic (1 tsp per packet) and lemon zest then season with salt and pepper. Divide butter pieces evenly among packets layering them over the shrimp and asparagus. Wrap packets in and crimp edges together then wrap ends up (don't wrap too tight - keep a little extra space inside for heat to circulate).
  6. Step 6
    Grill, sealed side upward, until shrimp has cooked through, about 9 - 10 minutes. Carefully unwrap then drizzle with lemon juice (or just serve with lemon wedges for spritzing) and sprinkle with parsley.
  7. Step 7
    Recipe source: Cooking Classy

Ingredients (7)

  • 20 oz verde enchilada sauce 2 10oz cans verde enchilada sauce
  • 2 cups cheese 2 cups shredded cheese
  • 4 lbs chicken pre 1 lb shredded chicken pre cooked; hall portion
  • 10 oz canned tomatoes 1 10oz can tomatoes with green chilis
  • 15 oz refried beans 1 15oz can refried beans
  • 6 flour tortillas torn into bite sized pieces 6-8 flour tortillas torn into bite sized pieces
  • 8 green onion tops optional

Steps (9)

  1. Step 1
    Heat oven to 37
  2. Step 2
    Prepare a 9 x 13 baking dish and begin by placing a layer of tortillas on the bottom of the dish.
  3. Step 3
    Then add a layer of chicken and 1/4 a cup of the shredded cheese.
  4. Step 4
    Add on half a can of tomatoes and green chilies and one can of the verde enchilada sauce.
  5. Step 5
    Finish the layer with a half a can of the refried beans.
  6. Step 6
    Then cover with another layer of flour tortilla pieces, and start the layering process again.
  7. Step 7
    Once you are finished layering, cover the top with the remaining shredded cheese.
  8. Step 8
    Cover with foil, and then bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Remove the foil, add a few green onion tops, and bake for an additional 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Allow to sit for 10-15 minutes to allow to cool before serving. Serving any sooner may give you a soupy, but still delicious dinner.

Ingredients (20)

  • 600 g beef 600g minced beef

  • 1 chilli 1 red chilli, finely chopped

  • 1 leaves coriander half Coriander leaves, half chopped, half whole or
  • 1 tsp ground coriander 1 tsp ground coriander
  • 1 egg 1 egg
  • 0.5 tsp sea salt ½ tsp sea salt
  • 250 g sausage 250g good quality sausage, chopped
  • 2 tbs olive oil 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 2 tbs harissa 2 Tbs harissa*
  • 480 g tomato 480g chopped tomato
  • 400 ml chicken stock 400ml chicken stock
  • 0.25 tsp cinnamon ¼ tsp cinnamon
  • 10 chili peppers 10-12 dried red chili peppers
  • 3 cloves garlic 3 cloves garlic, minced

  • 1 tsp ground caraway seeds 1 tsp ground caraway seeds
  • 0.5 tsp cumin ½ tsp cumin

Steps (8)

  1. Step 1
    Mix the beef, onion, chilli, spices and the chopped coriander leaves.

    Add the egg and salt, mix and combine.
  3. Step 3
    Form small meatballs about the size of a walnut (approximately 26 meatballs).
  4. Step 4
    Fry the meatballs and the sausage in olive oil in a large frying pan until browned all over (you may need to do this in batches).

    Scoop out, then add the harissa* and cook for a minute.
  6. Step 6
    Add the tomatoes, chicken stock and cinnamon. Simmer for 15 minutes.

    Return the meatballs and sausage and simmer for another 20 minutes, until cooked.
  8. Step 8
    Stir through the rest of the coriander to finish.

    Drain on paper towels and crumble into small pieces.

    Heat oven to 450 degrees.

    Place parchment paper on a baking pan and lightly flour.

    Brush a thin layer of pizza sauce on dough.

    Layer on crumbled sausage then mozzarella cheese.

Editorial QA

Ingredients (17)

  • 0.75 cups apple cider vinegar 1 cup apple cider vinegar
  • 1.5 cups barbecue sauce 2 cups barbecue sauce (see Ina's recipe below)
  • 2 tbsp chili powder 2 tablespoons chili powder
  • 0.75 cups dijon mustard 1 cup Dijon mustard
  • 0.75 tsp garlic Garlic crushed 1 teaspoon
  • 1 tbsp ground cumin 1 tablespoon ground cumin
  • 0.75 cups hoisin sauce 1 cup hoisin sauce
  • 0.75 cups honey 1 cup honey
  • 2 tbsp maple syrup 2 tablespoons maple syrup
  • 6.5 lbs boston butt pork shoulder 8 pounds Boston butt pork shoulder
  • 0 tbsp pepper flakes 1/2 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
  • 0.75 tsp soy sauce 1 teaspoon soy sauce
  • 1.5 tsp table salt 2 teaspoons table salt
  • 8 oz tomato paste 1 cup tomato paste (10 ounces)
  • 0.5 cups vegetable oil 1/2 cup vegetable oil
  • 0.5 cups worcestershire sauce 1/2 cup Worcestershire sauce
  • 1.25 cups onion 1 1/2 cups chopped yellow onion (1 large onion)

Steps (7)

  1. Step 1
    Massage mustard sauce into the meat. Wrap the meat tightly in a double layer of plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to 3 days. (The sauce was really thin and liquid-y so after dumping about half on the meat and realizing massaging was just not going to happen, I threw the meat and the sauce into a ziplock bag, shook it up and made sure it was coated then threw it in the fridge for the three day marinating marathon.)At least one hour prior to cooking, remove the roast from the refrigerator and unwrap, placing the meat and the marinating juices into a disposable 913 disposable aluminum pan and let it come to room temperature. (As I mentioned above, my pans were a bit flimsy so I doubled up.) Soak the wood chips in cold water to cover for 1 hour and drain.Meanwhile, light a large chimney starter filled halfway with charcoal (about 3 quarts) and allow to burn until the coals are partially covered with a layer of ash. Build a modified two-level fire by arranging all the coals over half of the grill, leaving the other half empty. Open the bottom grill vents completely.
  2. Step 2
    Place the wood chips on the coals. Set the cooking grate in place, cover and heat the grate until hot, about 5 minutes. Use a grill brush to scrape the cooking grate clean. Sip a wad of paper towels in vegetable oil; holding the wad with tongs, oil the cooking grate.Set the aluminum pan with the roast on the grate opposite the coals. Open the grill lid vents three-quarters of the way and cover, making sure the vent is above the meat to draw smoke through the grill. Cook, adding about eight briquettes every hour or so to maintain an average temperature of 275F for three hours. (When I added coals, I also basted the marinade over the roast to ensure moistness.)Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 325F. Wrap the pan holding the roast, being careful not to spill the marinating liquid, with heavy duty aluminum foil to cover completely.
  3. Step 3
    Place the pan in the oven and cook until the meat is fork-tender, about 2 hours.Carefully slide the foil-wrapped pan with the roast into a brown paper bag. Crimp the end shut.
  4. Step 4
    Let rest for 1 hour. (I found it easiest to lay the paper bag open on its side and slide the roast in, instead of dropping it downward, then folding the opening up and taping it shut.)While roast is resting, prepare barbecue sauce. If wanting true South Carolina style barbecue sauce, make the marinade above. If wanting a thicker, tangier sauce with a hot finish, I highly recommend Inas barbecue sauce below. Its a bit of an ingredient dump with 11 of 13 items being from jars and bottles, but with flavors so loud and clamoring for your taste-buds attention, you wont regret it.In a large sauce pan on low heat, saute onions and garlic with the oil until the onions are translucent, about 10 to 15 minutes.
  5. Step 5
    Add the rest of the ingredients. Simmer uncovered on low heat for 30 minutes. Use immediately or store in fridge. Makes about 6 cups.Keeping: This sauce freezes excellently. I made a big batch last fall and froze it, pulling it out for the pulled pork. I re-heated in a sauce pan on low heat until hot.Once pork has rested, transfer the roast to a carving board and dispose of the marinade liquid and pan. When cool enough to handle, separate the roast into sections, removing fat if desired, and tear the meat into shreds with your fingers (forks work just as well without your fingers getting messy).
  6. Step 6
    Place the shredded meat in a large bowl. Toss with 1 cup of the barbecue sauce, adding more to taste.
  7. Step 7
    Serve, passing the remaining sauce separately.

Ingredients (8)

  • 2.4 kg .6 lb. chicken legs and thighs. this weight usually gives me 4 legs and 4 thighs 1.2kg / 2.6 lb. chicken legs and thighs. This weight usually gives me 4 legs and 4 thighs.
  • 1000 ml pt. buttermilk 500ml / 1 pt. buttermilk
  • 2 tsp salt 1 x tsp salt
  • 300 gr oz. flour 150gr / 5 oz. plain flour
  • 4 tsps of spicy paprika powder 2 x tsps of spicy smoked paprika powder (you can also use the mild version, but I like spice)
  • 4 tsps thyme 2 x tsps dried thyme
  • 2 tsp pepper 1 x tsp freshly ground black pepper
  • 8 vegetable oil to fry the chicken Vegetable oil to fry the chicken (I like to use rapeseed oil or sunflower oil)

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    Pour the buttermilk into a tray or bowl add one teaspoon of salt, mix through and place the chicken pieces into the buttermilk. Depending on the size and shape of your bowl you may need a little bit more buttermilk in order that the chicken is covered. Cover with some cling film and place in the fridge for up to 8 hours.
  2. Step 2
    Remove before frying to give enough time to bring the meat up to room temperature.
  3. Step 3
    In a dish or bowl combine the flour, half teaspoon of salt, smoked paprika, thyme and pepper.
  4. Step 4
    Combine with your fingers or a fork.
  5. Step 5
    Remove the chicken from the buttermilk marinade and dispose of the marinade. Shake off most of the drips and then dredge the chicken in your flour mix making sure each piece is covered completely.
  6. Step 6
    Heat about 1.5cm / 0.5 in. of oil in a heavy bottomed wide pan. While this is heating up you can get a wire rack ready to drain the chicken. I do this by placing kitchen paper over the rack.
  7. Step 7
    The oil temperature should be about 170C / 340F for frying. I dont check with a thermometer but by putting a piece of bread in the oil and it is ready when it fizzes and turns brown quickly. The time the oil takes to heat up will depend on the thickness of the metal of your pan, your stove top and the quantity of oil you have used.
  8. Step 8
    You will probably have to cook in batches so as not to over load the pan. I start with the thighs which need a little bit more time than the legs.
  9. Step 9
    Place each one carefully in the pan and fry, covered, on a good strong simmer for anywhere between 8 to 12 minutes on each side. The heat needs to be high enough to give you a nice brown colour and a crisp finish.
  10. Step 10
    Remove and set on the rack to drain. Then do the same with the legs, giving them a couple of minutes less than the thighs.

Ingredients (15)

  • 48 chicken wings 24 chicken wings
  • 8 canola oil canola oil, for frying (peanut oil if available)
  • 8 cloves garlic 4 cloves garlic (or garlic powder)
  • 4 inch ginger 2-inch piece peeled ginger (or ginger powder)
  • 8 tbsp soy sauce 4 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 4 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp brown sugar
  • 2 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp sesame oil
  • 2 tbsp honey 1 tbsp honey
  • 4 tbsp ketchup 1, 2 tbsp ketchup
  • 2 tsp chili garlic sauce 1 tsp red chili garlic sauce (or red chili peppers)
  • 3 cups cornstarch 1 1/2 cup cornstarch
  • 2 cups water 1 cup water
  • 1 tsp salt and pepper 1/2 tsp salt and pepper
  • 8 sesame seeds & scallions sesame seeds & scallions (garnish)

Steps (8)

  1. Step 1
    Remove the tip of each chicken wing and cut in half at the joint to create 2 pieces. Rinse pieces under cold water and set to dry for at least 10 minutes. In a heavy pot such as a dutch oven, pour in canola or peanut oil to a depth of 2 inches.
  2. Step 2
    Heat over medium-high for about 7, 8 minutes or check for a deep-fry thermometer reading of 350F.
  3. Step 3
    In the meantime, combine sauce ingredients of soy, vinegar, sugar, honey, ketchup, sesame oil, red chili garlic sauce, and the powder seasoning (or adding the pulsed fresh ginger and garlic) in a small sauce pan. Boil until sauce slightly thickens and set at low heat. Adjust the spiciness of the sauce by slowly adding the red chili garlic sauce/red chili peppers and tasting for desired taste.
  4. Step 4
    In a large mixing bowl, mix 1 cup cornstarch and salt and pepper. Individually coat each chicken wing pieces with the cornstarch and set aside.
  5. Step 5
    In another bowl, whisk the remaining 3/4 cup cornstarch, and 3/4 cup water together to make a runny, liquidy batter.
  6. Step 6
    Add each chicken wing one at a time and coat well. Shake off excess batter and fry the chicken in batches for about 10~13 minutes, until golden brown, then drain on paper towels. Do not overcrowd the pan when frying each batch.
  7. Step 7
    Fry half of the chicken wings without the sauce and plate. For the flavored wings, simply coat chicken pieces with a brush or by tossing together in a mixing bowl.
  8. Step 8
    Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with sesame seeds and thin green onions slices. Enjoy and eat while hot!

Ingredients (7)

  • 4 lbs flank steak 1 1 ½ to 2 pounds flank steak trimmed; hall portion
  • 6 tbsp olive oil 3 tablespoon olive oil
  • 2 shallot 1 shallot finely chopped
  • 1 lb spinach ½ pound spinach, washed, stemmed and chopped
  • 1.5 cups bread crumbs ¾ cup fresh bread crumbs
  • 0.5 lbs gorgonzola ¼ pound Gorgonzola or other blue cheese, crumbled
  • 8 salt and pepper Salt and pepper

Steps (13)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat oven to 37
  2. Step 2
    Butterfly the steak by using a long sharp knife holding it parallel to the work surface, cut through the long side of the steak, stopping about inch from the opposite side. If the steak is already thin, just pound it with a mallet to inch thick.
  3. Step 3
    In a large skillet over medium heat add 1 tablespoon olive oil and saut` the shallots until soft, 2 minutes.
  4. Step 4
    Add the spinach and cook until just wilted, about 2 to 3 minutes.
  5. Step 5
    Transfer to a colander.
  6. Step 6
    When cool enough to handle, squeeze out all the moisture from the spinach and transfer to a medium bowl. Stir in the bread crumbs and cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
  7. Step 7
    Place the steak on a sheet of plastic wrap. Smear the spinach mixture evenly over the steak, leaving about 1 inch border along the side edge. Beginning with the side near you and using the plastic wrap as an aid, rollup the steak, gently pressing on the filling.
  8. Step 8
    Tie the rolled steak with twine at 2-3 inch interval.
  9. Step 9
    Season the outside with salt and pepper.
  10. Step 10
    Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium high heat. Sear the roast on all sided, about 2 minutes per side.
  11. Step 11
    Place in the oven and roast for 20 to 25 minutes.
  12. Step 12
    Transfer to a cutting board, tend with aluminum foil and allow resting for 10 minutes.
  13. Step 13
    To serve, remove the twine from the roast and cut into inch to 1 inch thick slices.

  • 8 country Asian-Style Country Ribs with Black Bean Garlic Sauce
  • 4 tsp sesame oil 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
  • 2 tbsp garlic 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh garlic
  • 2 tbsp ginger root 1 tablespoon freshly grated ginger root
  • 2 tbsp honey 1 tablespoon honey
  • 1 tsp coarsely cracked pepper 1/2 teaspoon coarsely cracked black pepper

Steps (2)

  1. Step 1
    This crock-pot entre is really, really good. It takes 10 minutes to prepare, is made from ingredients that are readily available and is a bargain when you consider the number of servings it provides. One caution - you'll have mush with Asian flavor if you cook this for more than 5 to 6 hours. The recipe is adapted from "Slow Cooker Recipes for All Occasions", a Rival Crock-Pot publication.
  2. Step 2
    Served with rice and snow peas you have the makings of a minor feast that you'll repeat often. My family loves this dish. I think yours will, too. This, by the way, is a wonderful recipe for novice cooks. If you have a willing teen, let them have a go at it.Asian-Style Country Ribs with Black Bean Garlic Sauce

Editorial QA

Ingredients (11)

  • 4 lbs hanger steak 1 lb hanger steak, trimmed if necessary
  • 32 oz carrots 2 c (8 oz) carrots, 1/2” slices
  • 32 oz mushrooms 2 c (8 oz) mushrooms, depending on size, roughly cut
  • 8 tbsp olive oil 2 Tbsp olive oil
  • 8 tsp salt and pepper 2 tsp salt and black pepper for the steak, a pinch each for vegetables
  • 2 tbsp worcestershire sauce 1/2 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 2 c butter 1/2 c (1 stick) unsalted butter
  • 8 tbsp parsley 2 Tbsp parsley, finely chopped
  • 4 tbsp sage 1 Tbsp sage, finely chopped
  • 4 cloves garlic 1 clove garlic, minced
  • 8 tsp lemon juice 2 tsp lemon juice

Steps (19)

  1. Step 1
    Hanger Steak and Vegetables
  2. Step 2
    Place oven rack at a position so that the meat will end up 6 inches under the broiler
  3. Step 3
    Preheat oven to broil (500°F)
  4. Step 4
    Dry meat with paper towels. Season generously with salt and freshly cracked black pepper
  5. Step 5
    Clean the mushrooms with a paper towel and roughly chop
  6. Step 6
    Peel the carrots and chop into ½“ slices
  7. Step 7
    Toss vegetables in a bowl with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, add Worcestershire sauce, and mix everything
  8. Step 8
    Place mixture onto a rimmed sheet pan, add the (slightly oiled) “cooling rack” upside down on top, and add the steak. Put your little architectural set up (carefully) in the oven.
  9. Step 9
    After about 6 minutes, turn the meat.
  10. Step 10
    Broil for another 6 minutes, check for desired temperature with a meat thermometer, then remove the meat and rest it on a cutting board, lightly tented with aluminum foil.  I like my steak medium-rare, so I remove it when the temperature reaches 130°F.
  11. Step 11
    Leave the vegetables in the oven for another 10 minutes or until they reach the softness you like. Use a fork to test them.
  12. Step 12
    Cut the hanger steak in slices against the grain and plate together with vegetables
  13. Step 13
    Add a couple slices of garlic herb compound butter on top of the steak. If you have some parsley handy, add some to make the plate look pretty.
  14. Step 14
    Garlic Herb Compound Butter (optional)
  15. Step 15
    Mash the softened butter in a bowl with a fork
  16. Step 16
    Add parsley, sage, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper and mix together with butter using a fork
  17. Step 17
    Spoon the butter onto a piece of plastic wrap or parchment paper
  18. Step 18
    Roll into a log and twist the ends
  19. Step 19
    Chill for at least 2 hours in the fridge

Ingredients (13)

  • 32 oz salmon steaks 2 (4-oz) salmon steaks
  • 4 tbsp mayonnaise 1 Tbsp mayonnaise
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce 1/2 Tbsp soy sauce
  • 4 tsp lemon juice 1 tsp lemon juice
  • 0.5 tsp kosher sea salt 1/8 tsp kosher sea salt
  • 8 tbsp breadcrumbs 2 Tbsp breadcrumbs
  • 8 tbsp parmesan 2 Tbsp Parmesan, grated
  • 4 tsp lemon zest 1 tsp lemon zest
  • 32 oz broccoli 8 oz broccoli, cut into bite-size florets
  • 8 cloves garlic 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 8 tbsp olive oil 2 Tbsp extra-virgin olive oil
  • 2 tsp pepper flakes 1/2 tsp hot pepper flakes
  • 2 tsp freshly cracked pepper 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper

Steps (9)

  1. Step 1
    In a bowl, combine a couple cloves of minced garlic with extra virgin olive oil, hot pepper flakes, kosher sea salt, and some freshly cracked pepper.
  2. Step 2
    Add broccoli and toss. 
  3. Step 3
    Line a baking sheet with heavy-duty aluminum foil and place the vegetables around the perimeter of the sheet pan, leaving room for the fish in the middle.
  4. Step 4
    In a second small mixing bowl, combine mayonnaise with a little soy sauce, lemon juice, and salt. 
  5. Step 5
    Place the fish in the middle of the sheet pan and coat it with the sauce, making sure to get the sides as well. 
  6. Step 6
    In a third small mixing bowl, combine breadcrumbs, Parmesan, and lemon zest.
  7. Step 7
    Generously apply breadcrumb mixture on top of the salmon steaks. 
  8. Step 8
    Bake for 15 minutes @ 400°F. To check for doneness, insert a fork in the center of the salmon steak…it should flake easily. And the vegetables should have a nice “al dente” bite. 
  9. Step 9
    Serve with a glass of Chardonnay.

Ingredients (8)

  • 0.25 cups butter ¼ cup butter
  • 3 chicken breasts 2 cooked and cubed chicken breasts
  • 14 oz cream of chicken soup 1 (10.5oz) can Cream of Chicken Soup
  • 14 oz cream of mushroom soup 1 (10.5oz) can Cream of Mushroom Soup
  • 27 oz tomatoes and chilis 2 (10oz) cans Tomatoes and Green Chilis
  • 13 flour tortillas 1 (10 count) package flour tortillas (torn into bite sized pieces)
  • 2.75 cups mexican cheddar jack cheese 2 cup package Mexican Cheddar Jack shredded cheese
  • 1.3 medium onion 1 medium onion

Steps (6)

  1. Step 1
    If you haven't already, cook your chicken breasts by boiling them in water for 20 minutes, or until juices run clear when cut into. Then cube and set aside.Preheat the oven to 35
  2. Step 2
    Chop the onion into small pieces and saute in cup butter over medium heat for 5 minutes or until slightly translucent. Turn heat down to low and add both cans of soup, stirring until mixed well.
  3. Step 3
    Remove from heat and set aside.In a prepared 9 x 13 baking dish place a layer of tortillas to cover the bottom of the dish.
  4. Step 4
    Add a thin layer of tomatoes and green chilis, a thin layer of the soup mixture, a thin layer of chicken, and top with cheese.
  5. Step 5
    Add another thin layer of tortillas, tomatoes and green chilis, soup mixture, chicken, and cheese. Keep doing the layers until you run out of space, finally covering the dish with the remaining cheese.
  6. Step 6
    Bake in the preheated oven on 350 for 45 minutes, or until cheese is turned a golden brown. Allow to cool before serving.

  • 16 slices bacon 4 slices bacon
  • 16 large pasteurized eggs 4 large pasteurized eggs
  • 8 tbsp olive oil 2 tablespoons olive oil

Steps (5)

    Serve with a large chunk of toasted baguette.

Ingredients (12)

  • 0.25 cups basil 1/4 cup basil
  • 1 bell pepper 1 bell pepper chopped
  • 4 lbs ground turkey 1 1/2 pounds lean ground turkey; hall portion
  • 16 oz mozzarella cheese 12 ounces mozzarella cheese
  • 1 onion 1 onion chopped
  • 0.25 cups parmesan 1/4 cup shredded parmesan
  • 0.25 cups parsley 1/4 cup parsley
  • 20 oz ricotta cheese 15 ounces ricotta cheese
  • 1.25 tsp sugar 1 teaspoon sugar
  • 37 oz tomato sauce 28 ounces tomato sauce
  • 1.25 tsp pepper 1 teaspoon white pepper
  • 5.3 large zucchini 4 large zucchini

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat the oven to 375F. Slice the zucchini lengthwise and lay it flat on a cookie sheet.
  2. Step 2
    Bake in the oven for 15 minutes. This is very important in order to bake out most of the liquid.
  3. Step 3
    In a medium saucepan, saut the onion and bell pepper.
  4. Step 4
    Add in the ground turkey and cook thoroughly.
  5. Step 5
    Mix in the tomato sauce and seasonings. Turn the heat to low and allow it to simmer for 5 minutes.
  6. Step 6
    In a separate bowl, mix together the ingredients for your cheese mixture and set aside. In a 9 x 13 baking dish, layer the bottom with zucchini noodles.
  7. Step 7
    Spread the cheese mixture over the zucchini and add a layer of meat sauce. Repeat these steps to create the layers for your zucchini lasagna. Top with mozzarella cheese and cover the baking dish with foil.
  8. Step 8
    Bake the zucchini lasagna in the oven for 30 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Remove the foil and then cook an additional 10 minutes.
  10. Step 10
    Remove from the oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Editorial QA

Ingredients (10)

  • 40 corn husks 20 dried corn husks
  • 12 california chili pods 6 dried California chili pods, seeded with the ends cut off
  • 3 cups ground beef 1 1/2 cups ground beef
  • 2 cups mozzarella cheese 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
  • 1 poblano pepper 1/2 1 poblano pepper, diced
  • 8 cloves garlic 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 4 tbsp olive oil 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 3 packets goya seasoning 1 1/2 packets Goya seasoning with onion and garlic
  • 4 tsp salt 2 teaspoons salt
  • 2 tsp chili powder 1 teaspoon chili powder

Steps (16)

  1. Step 1
    In a large bowl, allow corn husks to soak in hot water. In a large saucepan, bring 4 cups of water to a boil.
  2. Step 2
    Remove any string-like particles from the chili pods.
  3. Step 3
    Add them to the boiling water along with half of a packet of Goya seasoning. Cover and let boil for about 20 minutes.
  4. Step 4
    Afterwards, place chili pods with 2 cups of the stock in a blender to coalesce.
  5. Step 5
    Drain the saucepan of the remaining stock and place back on the stove top. Return the heat to medium, and add olive oil once the remaining stock evaporates.
  6. Step 6
    Add onion and beef, and immediately begin to break apart the beef.
  7. Step 7
    Add 1 packet of Goya seasoning and chili powder, and allow to cook for 5 minutes.
  8. Step 8
    Add the chili sauce and cook an additional 5 minutes.
  9. Step 9
    Add garlic and 2 teaspoon salt. I added the poblano pepper at this point, but I should have added it with the beef and onion.
  10. Step 10
    Reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for one hour. For the last twenty minutes, partially cover the pan in order to slightly reduce. Most of the liquid should be reduced and thickened.
  11. Step 11
    In a large bowl, add instant corn masa mix, water, baking powder, salt, and olive oil to create corn masa mix. The mixture should be spongy.
  12. Step 12
    Whats surprisingly tricky is assembling the tamales. The best technique Ive found is to thinly spread the tamale masa mix starting from the right-hand side of the corn husks, and leaving about 2 inches on the left-hand side of the husk. When rolling the tamale together, take the right-hand side and fold it onto the rest of the corn husk covered with tamale masa mix. The 1-2 inches left over should roll perfectly over the actual tamale. Dont overstuff the tamales! Id say 2 tablespoon of meat mixture and just a sparse amount of cheese.
  13. Step 13
    O cook, you should have a double boiler. If you dont, like me, then use a metal colander and place it in a large pot.
  14. Step 14
    Place the tamales in the colander (or double boiler) where they are not squished, nor are they loose enough to unravel themselves. While doing this, boil 2 cups of water in the pot or what equates to 1 inch in height of the water.
  15. Step 15
    Once water comes to a boil, reduce heat and add the tamales.
  16. Step 16
    Place a towel between the colander and lid, and cook for 30 minutes.

Ingredients (12)

  • 60 oz beans 2 (15 oz.) cans of white beans (Great Northern or Cannellini), rinsed and drained
  • 1 c carrots 2 carrots, peeled and chopped (about 1/2 c.)
  • 2 loaf bread 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices
  • 4 sprigs rosemary 2 sprigs fresh rosemary
  • 2 cloves garlic 1 clove of garlic, minced (I grated mine on a microplane)
  • 10 c chicken broth 5 c. low-sodium chicken broth
  • 8 t olive oil 4 T. olive oil
  • 2 small onion 1 small onion, diced
  • 6 oz prosciutto 3 oz. prosciutto, chopped
  • 2 dash pepper flakes dash of red pepper flakes
  • 8 salt & pepper
  • 2 bunch spinach 1 bunch of fresh spinach, washed and stems removed

Steps (7)

  1. Step 1
    Heat 1 T. olive oil in a dutch oven at med-high heat.
  2. Step 2
    Add chopped prosciutto and cook, stirring to break up the clumpy pieces, until crisped, 5-7 minutes.
  3. Step 3
    Remove with a slotted spoon to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. To the fat in the pan, add the garlic head, cut-side down, onion, carrot and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring occasionally until onion is softened, about 5-8 minutes.
  4. Step 4
    Add 1 sprig rosemary, broth and beans. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until the garlic is soft, about 30 minutes, removing the rosemary sprig halfway through cooking.Meanwhile, heat the oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl combine 3 T. olive oil, chopped rosemary from the other sprig, and minced garlic.
  5. Step 5
    Spread the bread slices out on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes, remove from the oven, flip the slices and brush with the rosemary &amp; garlic oil. Continue baking until the toasts are crisp, 5-10 minutes longer. Set aside while the soup finishes.When the head of garlic is tender, remove it from the soup. When cool enough to handle, squeeze out the cloves and mince fine.
  6. Step 6
    Add back to the soup, make sure the soup is at a gentle simmer, add in the spinach and cook until just wilted, just a minute or two. Adjust the seasoning with salt &amp; pepper.
  7. Step 7
    Serve the soup topped with the crisp prosciutto bits and the rosemary-garlic toasts.

Ingredients (9)

  • 1.25 lbs spaghetti 1 pound spaghetti
  • 0.75 cups almonds 1/2 cup (80 gr) almonds (if you can get the Sicilian ones from Noto they are wonderful)
  • 0.25 cups pine nuts 1/4 cup (30 gr) pine nuts
  • 0.75 cups extra virgin olive oil 1/2 cup (100 gr) extra virgin olive oil
  • 4 garlic cloves 3 garlic cloves
  • 3 tomatoes 2 tomatoes, peeled and seeded
  • 3.25 cups basil 2 1/2 cups (60 gr) basil
  • 8 salt and pepper Salt and pepper as needed
  • 8 pecorino Ricotta salata or pecorino, to be grated fresh over the past

Steps (4)

  1. Step 1
    Place a large (this is key) pot of water to boil. Salt when it boils, not before.
  2. Step 2
    Meanwhile, make the pesto: In a mortar (or use a food processor with a blade) pound together the oil, almonds and pine-nuts.
  3. Step 3
    Add the garlic, 2 ice cubes and the rest of the ingredients, pounding quickly to make a paste.You want to leave a bit of a texture for crunch.
  4. Step 4
    Cook the pasta al dente, as per directions, drain and reserve some of the boiling water. Toss the pasta with the pesto, using some of the reserved water to make it creamier. Grate some fresh pecorino or ricotta salata (or both) over and serve hot with a leaf of basil to garnish.

Ingredients (9)

  • 5 lbs beef chuck roast 1 2-2 ½ Lb. Boneless Beef Chuck Roast
  • 2 onion 1 Large Onion – Roughly chopped

  • 4 tbsp cooking tapioca 2 Tbsp. Quick Cooking Tapioca

    In a small bowl whisk together broth, vinegar, tomato paste, tapioca, garlic and Italian seasoning.

    Pour mixture over meat.

    Set cooker on low and cook for 8-10 hours. If youre short on time set cooker to high and cook 4-5 hours.

    Let cook without disturbing or checking on it; Every time you open the lid it lets all that precious hot air out. I was bummed to come home and find that my lid somehow and fallen in and created a constant leak. But it all worked out just fine in the end.

    Use juice and onions in crockpot as gravy.

    Transfer liquid to a gravy boat.
  11. Step 11
    Plate it up
  12. Step 12
    ENJOY!!!

Ingredients (20)

  • 2.75 cups brown rice 2/3 cup dried brown rice (2 cups cooked)
  • 2.7 medium carrots 2 medium carrots, sliced
  • 2.7 stalks celery 2 stalks celery, sliced
  • 1.25 tsp celery seed 1 teaspoon celery seed
  • 2.75 cups kidney beans 2/3 cup dried kidney beans (2 cups cooked)
  • 1.25 tsp marjoram 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
  • 2.75 tsp thyme 2 teaspoons dried thyme
  • 1.3 medium eggplant 1 medium eggplant, chopped
  • 3 cloves garlic 2 cloves garlic, minced or crushed
  • 4 handfuls green beans 3 handfuls of green beans, chopped
  • 8 ground pepper fresh ground black pepper
  • 2.75 tsp ground sage 2 teaspoons ground sage
  • 0.75 tsp liquid smoke 1/2 to 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, to taste
  • 3 tbsp olive oil 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 bell pepper 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
  • 1.3 small onion 1 small white or red onion, diced
  • 2 tsp sea salt 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt, or to taste
  • 1.25 tsp sriracha 1 teaspoon sriracha or other hot sauce
  • 2.7 medium tomatoes 2 medium tomatoes, diced
  • 4 cups vegetable stock 3 cups vegetable stock

Steps (6)

  1. Step 1
    Rinse the kidney beans and brown rice separately. Cover the kidney beans with water and soak for 8 hours or overnight. In a separate bowl, cover the brown rice with water and soak for 8 hours or overnight.
  2. Step 2
    Drain and rinse the kidney beans, then transfer to a medium saucepan and cover with fresh water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour or until just tender but not falling apart.
  3. Step 3
    Drain and set aside.
  4. Step 4
    Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. When hot, add the onion and saut for 5 minutes. Now add the garlic, carrots, celery and green beans, and stir for another 5 minutes. Next add the tomatoes, red pepper, eggplant, sage, thyme, marjoram and celery seed, and continue to stir for another few minutes.
  5. Step 5
    Pour in the vegetable stock, liquid smoke, rice and the cooked kidney beans. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes or until the rice is tender.
  6. Step 6
    Add water as necessary if the stew becomes too dry.Season with sriracha, salt and pepper, and taste for seasoning add more liquid smoke, sriracha, salt, pepper or herbs as desired.

Editorial QA

Ingredients (13)

  • 0.5 cups water 1 cup Water
  • 0.25 cups cracked wheat 1/3 cups Coaches Oats Or Cracked Wheat
  • 0.75 tsp active yeast 2-¼ teaspoons Active Dry Yeast
  • 0 tsp granulated sugar ¼ teaspoons Granulated Sugar
  • 0.25 cups warm water 1/3 cups Warm Water
  • 1 tbsp butter 2 Tablespoons Butter
  • 0 tbsp table salt 1 Tablespoon Table Salt
  • 1 tbsp molasses 2 Tablespoons Molasses
  • 1 tbsp honey 2 Tablespoons Honey
  • 1 tbsp wheat germ 2 Tablespoons Wheat Germ
  • 0.5 cups milk 1 cup Milk, Warm
  • 1.25 cups flour 3 cups Whole Wheat Flour
  • 0 egg white 1 whole Egg White For Egg Wash

Steps (21)

  1. Step 1
    In a small saucepan, bring the 1 cup water and the Coaches Oats to a boil, turn down to medium low and simmer for about 6 minutes.
  2. Step 2
    Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm.
  3. Step 3
    Dissolve the yeast in a medium sized bowl with 1/3 cup warm water and the sugar. Stir together, then let sit 10 minutes.
  4. Step 4
    Add the Coach Oats mixture to yeast mixture and add the butter, salt, molasses, honey, wheat germ and milk to the bowl of an electric mixer and with the paddle attachment, mix together to combine.
  5. Step 5
    Add the one cup of whole wheat flour and two cups of the all purpose flour.
  6. Step 6
    Mix until well combined. Clean off the paddle attachment, scrape the sides of the bowl and add the dough attachment to the mixer.
  7. Step 7
    With the mixer going on low speed, add the remaining whole wheat flour a little at a time until the dough starts coming together.
  8. Step 8
    After two of the remaining cups are added, let the mixer knead the dough for a minute or so. If it is still sticking to the sides, add about 1/4 cup more flour, let it mix. Keep adding a little flour at a time until the ball of dough no longer sticks to the sides.
  9. Step 9
    Let it knead for 8-10 minutes on medium-low speed.
  10. Step 10
    Remove the bowl from the mixer.
  11. Step 11
    Take the dough out of the bowl and spray it with cooking spray. Return the ball of dough to the bowl, cover it with a towel or plastic wrap and let sit in a warm, dry place for an hour until doubled in size (mine took almost 2 hours).
  12. Step 12
    Punch down the dough and make 2.50 ounce sized balls of doughyoull get about 19 rolls. Set them on a baking sheet and cover with a tea towel.
  13. Step 13
    Let them rise for about 45 minutes.
  14. Step 14
    During the last 20 minutes of rise time, preheat oven to 375 degrees.
  15. Step 15
    Fill a dutch oven or oven safe pot with water and place on the lowest shelf of the oven, this will add steam in the oven.
  16. Step 16
    Brush each roll with egg wash.
  17. Step 17
    Bake the rolls for 17-23 minutes (you may have to do this in two batches, unless you have a huge oven).
  18. Step 18
    Let the rolls sit on the baking sheet sit for a few minutes, then remove rolls from pan and place on a wire rack to cool completely.
  19. Step 19
    NOTE: Due to the molasses, the rolls will have a brown tone, so when your baking them, make sure the bottom has a light brown color to them, at first I thought I was over cooking the rolls, and I wasnt, 19 minutes seemed to be perfect amount of time.
  20. Step 20
    Serving Size: 19 2.5 oz rolls
  21. Step 21
    Calories per roll: 145, Fat: 1.2, Cholesterol: .03, Sodium: 20, Potassium: 117, Carbs: 29, Fiber: 3, Sugar: 3.8, Protein: 4.9

Ingredients (15)

  • 4 tbsp apple cider vinegar 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
  • 1 tbsp butter 1 tablespoon butter
  • 2.75 tsp mustard 2 teaspoons dry mustard
  • 2.7 large eggs 2 large eggs
  • 1 tbsp thyme 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, finely chopped
  • 3 garlic cloves 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • 0.75 tsp ground pepper 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
  • 4 lbs a mixture of 1 pound ground chuck and 1 ground pork 2 pounds pounds ground chuck or a mixture of 1 pound ground chuck and 1 ground pork or veal; hall portion
  • 4 tbsp honey 3 tablespoons honey
  • 0.25 cups milk 1/4 cup milk
  • 1.3 medium onion 1 medium onion, chopped
  • 0.75 tsp salt 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 11 slices bacon 8 slices thick-cut bacon
  • 8 oz tomato paste 6 oz. can tomato paste, divided
  • 4 tbsp water 3 tablespoons water

Steps (5)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat the oven to 350 F.Melt the butter in a small skillet over medium-low heat; cook the onion until soft but not brown, about 5 minutes.
  2. Step 2
    Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
  3. Step 3
    Remove from heat and set aside.
  4. Step 4
    Place a rack on or in a large, glass baking dish. Alternating slightly, lay the strips of bacon across the rack, one end in the middle and allowing the other end to hang over the side of the dish. Set aside.In a small bowl, mix 3 tablespoons of the tomato paste with the water, apple cider vinegar, honey, prepared mustard and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Set aside.In a large mixing bowl, combine the remaining ingredients with the onion/garlic mixture and the remaining tomato paste and gently but thoroughly mix with your hands. Form into a loaf directly on top of the bacon, leaving enough of the bacon uncovered to wrap the top of the meatloaf. Spoon the glaze over the top of the meatloaf and spread down the sides, covering it completely. Lift the ends of the bacon hanging down the sides and place over the top of the meatloaf.
  5. Step 5
    Bake for an hour, or until the meatloaf is cooked through and the bacon is brown and crisp. Allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving.

Ingredients (7)

  • 8 medium zucchini 4 medium zucchini, julienned thinly (mandoline slicers are great for this)
  • 2 pinch salt generous pinch of salt
  • 12 slices bacon 6 slices of uncooked bacon
  • 1 cup green onions 1/2 cup green onions, sliced into 1-inch pieces
  • 4 cups broccoli florets 2 cups broccoli florets
  • 4 t basil pesto 2-3 T prepared basil pesto
  • 8 romano cheese Fresh Parmesan or Romano cheese, for garnish

Steps (11)

  1. Step 1
    Place zucchini strips in a colander over a bowl or in the sink.
  2. Step 2
    Sprinkle zucchini with salt and toss to combine.
  3. Step 3
    Let the zucchini sit for 15 minutes while the salt extracts the moisture.
  4. Step 4
    Drain excess water, squeezing zucchini, if necessary.
  5. Step 5
    Meanwhile, cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, turning frequently.
  6. Step 6
    Remove bacon to a stack of paper towels to drain. Crumble bacon.
  7. Step 7
    Remove all but 2 T of bacon drippings from the pan.
  8. Step 8
    Return the pan to medium heat.
  9. Step 9
    Add the green onions and broccoli, stirring frequently for about 3-5 minutes or until crisp-tender.
  10. Step 10
    Add zucchini and 2 T of pesto, tossing to combine all ingredients. Taste and add more pesto, if needed. The mixture only needs to warm up, so 2-3 minutes of cooking ought to do it.
  11. Step 11
    Serve with bacon crumbles and freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

Ingredients (10)

  • 8 rosemary fresh rosemary
  • 8 cloves garlic 2 cloves garlic
  • 16 large mushrooms 4 large mushrooms, chopped
  • 8 olive oil
  • 8 parmesan cheese Parmesan cheese
  • 1 cup red wine 1/4 cup red wine for sauce
  • 8 salt and pepper
  • 2 savoy cabbage 1/2 savoy cabbage
  • 200 grams walnuts 50 grams walnuts, toasted
  • 800 grams spaghetti 200 grams whole wheat spaghetti

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    In a small skillet, fry the garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
  2. Step 2
    Add the mushrooms. When the mushrooms are almost done, add the fresh rosemary, be careful not to let it burn.
  3. Step 3
    In a large skillet, fry the chopped savoy cabbage until the desired level of crispiness is achieved.
  4. Step 4
    Once the cabbage is nearly done, pour half of the bottle of wine into a pot. Dilute with boiling water until you have enough to cook the pasta in (but try not to dilute it too much). Bring to a boil and salt the water.
  5. Step 5
    Add the spaghetti.
  6. Step 6
    Drain the pasta, reserving about 1/4 cup of the pasta water.
  7. Step 7
    Add the pasta to the skillet with the cabbage.
  8. Step 8
    Add the mushrooms and rosemary (you might want to de-glaze the pan they were in with some more wine).
  9. Step 9
    Add the reserved wine/water mixture to the pan with the pasta and cabbage. Season with salt and pepper.
  10. Step 10
    Add olive oil if it's too dry, and don't forget plenty of Parmesan.

Ingredients (11)

  • 2 nine-inch pie shell 1 nine-inch pie shell
  • 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 4 onions 2 white onions, sliced finely
  • 6 cloves garlic 3 cloves of garlic, sliced finely
  • 1 tsp chilli flakes 1/2 teaspoon dried chilli flakes
  • 2 box mushrooms 1 box mushrooms, sliced thick
  • 2 tsp thyme 1 teaspoon thyme, dried
  • 4 eggs 2 eggs
  • 1.5 cups half and half cream 3/4 cup half and half cream
  • 200 grams havarti cheese 100 grams Havarti cheese, grated
  • 8 salt and pepper salt and pepper to taste

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    Heat the oven to 400F. Dock the pie shell with a fork and bake for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly golden.
  2. Step 2
    In the meantime, heat the olive oil.
  3. Step 3
    Add the onions along with the garlic and chilli flakes and cook on high until the onion caramelise (about ten minutes).
  4. Step 4
    Now add the mushrooms and continue to cook on high so the mushrooms caramelise as well, about five minutes. Take off the fire, add the thyme and salt and pepper to taste.
  5. Step 5
    Beat the eggs in a large bowl with the cream and half the quantity of cheese.
  6. Step 6
    Add the onion-mushroom mixture and mix well.
  7. Step 7
    Place the pie shell on a cookie tray to catch any spillage.
  8. Step 8
    Pour the filling into the pie shell. Top the quiche with the remaining cheese.
  9. Step 9
    Drop the temperature to 375F and cook until the filling is set and golden.
  10. Step 10
    Serve when still warm from the oven.

Ingredients (11)

  • 10 eggs 5 eggs
  • 1.5 lbs asparagus 1 small bunch of thin asparagus (about 3/4 pound), washed, trimmed, and cut into 1-inch pieces
  • 2 tbsp butter 1 tablespoon butter
  • 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 3 tbsp heavy whipping cream 1-1/2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
  • 2 tbsp thyme 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped and divided
  • 2 garlic clove 1 garlic clove, minced
  • 0.5 tsp salt 1/4 teaspoon salt
  • 0.5 tsp ground pepper 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
  • 6 oz asiago cheese 3 ounces Asiago cheese, sliced thin
  • 8 cherry tomatoes 4-5 cherry tomatoes sliced in half, and 6, 4-inch asparagus spears for garnish

Steps (10)

  1. Step 1
    In a large bowl, combine the eggs, whipping cream, salt, pepper, and half the fresh thyme. Beat with a whisk until the eggs and cream are incorporated.
  2. Step 2
    In an ovenproof saut pan over medium heat, add the butter and olive oil. When the mixture is hot, add the asparagus pieces and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring.
  3. Step 3
    Add the garlic and cook for about a minute.
  4. Step 4
    Spread the asparagus so it is evenly distributed across the bottom of the pan.
  5. Step 5
    Add the egg mixture to the pan and allow the eggs to cook without mixing them. Use a rubber spatula to run around the edges of the frittata as it cooks so the edges dont stick and burn. After 1-2 minutes, add the cheese evenly to the egg mixture.
  6. Step 6
    When the outer edges of the frittata have set but the center is still slightly runny, arrange the cherry tomatoes and asparagus spears on the top of the frittata, sprinkle the remaining thyme over the top, then remove the pan from the heat and place it in an oven set to broil.
  7. Step 7
    The broiler will allow the top portion of the egg mixture to set and cook thoroughly. Keep a close watch so the frittata doesnt burn.
  8. Step 8
    After a few minutes, when the eggs have set completely and begin to turn golden, carefully remove the pan from the oven.
  9. Step 9
    Use a rubber spatula to run around the edges and underside of the frittata, and slide it onto a round serving plate.
  10. Step 10
    Slice and serve warm or at room temperature.

Ingredients (12)

  • 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 Tbsp brown sugar
  • 1 tsp cayenne 1 teaspoon cayenne
  • 4 tbsp chili powder 4 Tbsp chili powder
  • 0.25 tsp cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
  • 1 tsp garlic powder 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1 pinch ground cloves pinch of ground cloves
  • 2 tsp ground cumin 2 teaspoons ground cumin
  • 1 tbsp kosher salt 1 Tbsp kosher salt
  • 1 tsp onion powder 1 teaspoon onion powder
  • 1 tsp ground oregano 1 teaspoon ground oregano
  • 4 lbs pork shoulder roast 3 1/2 pound boneless pork shoulder roast; hall portion
  • 2 tbsp vegetable oil 2 Tbsp vegetable oil

Steps (8)

  1. Step 1
    Whisk together the rub ingredients in a small bowl.2 If the roast is tied up with butcher string, untie it. Pat the roast dry with paper towels. Rub the spice mix into the roast all over, reserving any leftover spice mix for later.
  2. Step 2
    Let sit at room temperature at least one hour or chill overnight. 3
  3. Step 3
    Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan on medium high heat. (If you are using a slow cooker with a removable container that can be used on the stovetop, use that, otherwise use a separate pan.)
  4. Step 4
    Place the roast in the pan and brown on all sides.4
  5. Step 5
    Place the roast in a slow cooker, and add any reserved spice rub. Cook on the low setting for 6 to 10 hours, until the pork is fall apart tender. 5
  6. Step 6
    Remove the roast from the slow cooker and place on a cutting board.
  7. Step 7
    Cut into large chunks. Then use two forks to pull the meat apart into bite sized shreds. Return the shreds to the slow cooker and toss to coat with the juice from the roast. (Alternatively you can just shred the roast with two forks in the slow cooker itself.)
  8. Step 8
    Serve with warm tortillas, avocados, shredded cabbage, sliced radishes, cilantro, and a splash of lime juice or salsa.

Ingredients (11)

  • 4 lbs shrimp 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled and deveined; hall portion
  • 4 lbs sausage 1 lb fully cooked smoked sausage; hall portion
  • 1.5 lbs potatoes 3/4 lb small potatoes (or larger ones cut in wedges)
  • 4 ears corn 2 ears corn, cut into 2-inch pieces
  • 20 oz pack portobello mushrooms 10 oz pack whole portobello mushrooms, with larger ones cut in half
  • 8 cloves garlic 4 cloves garlic, smashed and chopped
  • 2 jalapeño 1 jalapeño, deseeded and chopped
  • 2 lemon 1 lemon, cut in wedges
  • 0.5 c old bay seasoning 1/4 c Old Bay seasoning
  • 0.5 c butter 1/4 c butter
  • 4 tbsp parsley 2 Tbsp parsley, chopped

Steps (11)

  1. Step 1
    To make sure everything will be perfectly cooked at the same time, you’ll need to parboil the potatoes and corn. This is done by cooking the small potatoes (or larger ones cut in wedges) for about 12 minutes in a pot of boiling salt water.
  2. Step 2
    Add the corn for the last 5 minutes.
  3. Step 3
    Drain well and place in a large bowl. 
  4. Step 4
    While your potatoes and corn are boiling, defrost the shrimp in lukewarm water, pat dry, and add to the bowl. 
  5. Step 5
    Cut your favorite pre-cooked sausage in small slices and add to the bowl.
  6. Step 6
    If you want to add some extra umami, chop some brown mushrooms and add them to the bowl as well. And add a chopped jalapeño, to spice it up a bit. 
  7. Step 7
    To make the marinade, in a separate bowl, melt 4 Tbsp (¼ cup) butter with ¼ cup Old Bay, add at least 6 garlic cloves (we like it garlicky), and stir well.
  8. Step 8
    Pour the marinade over the ingredients in the bowl and mix well. Everything should be lightly coated.
  9. Step 9
    Lightly oil a sheet pan, toss the contents of the bowl once more, and spread it out to create one layer.
  10. Step 10
    Add a couple lemon slices and put in the oven at 400℉ for about 15 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and opaque.
  11. Step 11
    Garnish with some chopped Italian flat leaf parsley and serve by itself or with some garlic bread (I told you we like it garlicky around here) and a glass off your favorite white wine.

Ingredients (18)

  • 2 tbsp ▢ butter ▢ 2 tbsp unsalted butter
  • 4 lbs ▢ sausage ▢ 1 lb sliced sausage; hall portion
  • 4 lbs ▢ chicken breasts ▢ 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into bite sized pieces; hall portion
  • 1 cup ▢ onion ▢ 1 cup yellow onion chopped
  • 1 cup ▢ celery ▢ 1 cup celery chopped
  • 0.5 cups ▢ bell pepper ▢ 1/2 cup bell pepper chopped
  • 1 tbsp ▢ garlic ▢ 1 tbsp minced garlic
  • 1 cup ▢ tomato sauce ▢ 1 cup tomato sauce
  • 15 oz ▢ tomatoes ▢ 14.5 oz diced tomatoes
  • 2.5 cups ▢ chicken stock ▢ 2 1/2 cups chicken stock
  • 1.5 cups ▢ rice ▢ 1 1/2 cups rice uncooked and rinsed
  • 1 leaves ▢ 2 bay ▢ 2 bay leaves whole
  • 2 tsp ▢ ground pepper ▢ 2 tsp ground black pepper
  • 1 tsp ▢ salt ▢ 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp ▢ pepper ▢ 1 tsp white pepper
  • 1 tsp ▢ thyme ▢ 1 tsp thyme dried
  • 1 tsp ▢ pepper flakes ▢ 1 tsp red pepper flakes
  • 0.5 tsp ▢ sage ▢ 1/2 tsp sage

Steps (13)

  1. Step 1
    Combine the creole seasoning ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.
  2. Step 2
    Melt butter in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat.
  3. Step 3
    Add the sausage until it starts to brown, about 3 minutes.
  4. Step 4
    Add the chicken and continue to cook until brown, about 3-5 minutes. Stir frequently.
  5. Step 5
    Turn the stove top down to medium heat.
  6. Step 6
    Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.
  7. Step 7
    Stir in the seasoning mix of cajun spices and 1/2 of the chopped onion, celery, green bell pepper, and garlic. Cook until vegetables get tender, about 3-5 minutes. Stir frequently and scrape the bottom of the pot frequently.
  8. Step 8
    Stir in the tomato sauce and cook for about one minute.
  9. Step 9
    Stir in the remaining onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, and the diced tomatoes then remove from heat.
  10. Step 10
    Stir in the rice and chicken stock, mix the ingredients well.
  11. Step 11
    Bake uncovered in the oven at 350 degrees for one hour or until the rice is tender but still has a little crunch.
  12. Step 12
    Remove from the oven, add the bay leaves and stir well.
  13. Step 13
    Allow the dish to cool for five minutes before serving. OPTIONAL: Top with green onions before serving.

Ingredients (20)

  • 4 lbs beef short ribs 3 lbs of boneless beef short ribs; hall portion
  • 0.5 cups elbow macaroni 1/2 cup uncooked elbow macaroni
  • 16 cups water 4 qts 16 cups of water 4 Qts
  • 28 oz canned tomatoes 1 28oz can diced tomatoes
  • 1 cup potatoes 1 cup of small diced potatoes
  • 1 cup on carrots 1 cup on thin sliced carrots
  • 1 cup celery 1 cup thin sliced celery
  • 1.5 cups onion 1 1/2 cups chopped onion
  • 15 oz kernal corn 1 15oz kernal corn (uncooked)
  • 15 oz butter beans 1 15oz can butter beans
  • 15 oz eyed peas 1 15oz can black – eyed peas
  • 2 bay leaves 2 bay leaves
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 Tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp celery salt 1 tsp celery salt
  • 1 tbsp worcestershire sauce 1 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 1 tbsp salt 1 Tbsp salt
  • 1 tbsp ground pepper 1 Tbsp fresh ground pepper
  • 1 tbsp seasoning 1 Tbsp Italian seasoning
  • 2 beef bouillon cubes 2 beef bouillon cubes
  • 2 tbsp parsley 2 Tbsp dried parsley or fresh parsley

Steps (6)

  1. Step 1
    To get started, bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot. 
  2. Step 2
    While waiting on the water to boil, cut the beef short ribs into bite-sized pieces and add them to the water.
  3. Step 3
    Add in diced tomatoes, potatoes, diced onion, parsley, garlic powder, beef bouillon cubes, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, celery salt, bay leaves, and stir.
  4. Step 4
    Then add carrots, celery, black-eyed peas, butter beans, corn, and macaroni.
  5. Step 5
    Heat on high, stirring occasionally until the stew mixture comes to a boil.
  6. Step 6
    Once you have reached a boil, cover with a lid, lower heat enough to keep it simmering.  Continue to simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

Ingredients (9)

  • 4 avocados 2 avocados
  • 0.75 cups olives 1/3 cup black olives
  • 30 oz black beans 15 oz can low-sodium black beans
  • 1 cup corn 1/2 cup corn
  • 32 oz enchilada sauce 16 oz enchilada sauce
  • 0.5 cups cilantro 1/4 cup fresh cilantro
  • 2 cups reduced fat cheddar cheese 1 cup shredded reduced fat cheddar cheese
  • 4 cups rotisserie chicken 2 cups cooked rotisserie chicken
  • 4 small spaghetti squash 2 small spaghetti squash

Steps (4)

  1. Step 1
    If you don't have have your chicken already prepared or have leftovers, cook the chicken breasts and shred or dice.Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti squash. Two methods to cook the squash: #1- Microwave by placing squash in a baking dish, cut size down and fill the dish with an inch of water. Microwave on high for about 8-12 minutes (rotating a few times) or until the outside is soft enough to be pierced with a fork. #2-
  2. Step 2
    Brush inner flesh with oil, season with salt and pepper and roast in a 400 F oven, cut side up in a baking dish until tender, about 30-40 min.
  3. Step 3
    Mix together the chicken, enchilada sauce, beans, corn, olives, cilantro and cheese (save some of the cheese for topping).Scrape the sides of the spaghetti squash so the "noodles" are tossed and more loose.Divide the enchilada mixture between the squash boats and top with the extra cheese you saved.Broil in the oven until the cheese is melted and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
  4. Step 4
    Garnish with cilantro and top with avocado slices (if using).

Ingredients (9)

  • 4 avocados 2 very ripe avocados, pitted and skins removed
  • 4 tbsp buttermilk 2 tablespoons buttermilk
  • 8 strips bacon 4 strips of bacon, cooked until crisp and chopped
  • 0.5 cups parsley 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
  • 12 oz goat's cheese 6 ounces goat's cheese, crumbled
  • 8 salt and pepper salt and black pepper
  • 1 cup cream 1/2 cup sour cream (plain Greek yogurt may be substituted)
  • 8 medium sweet potatoes 4 medium sweet potatoes
  • 12 tbsp butter 6 tablespoons unsalted butter

Steps (11)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F. Poke your sweet potatoes with a fork and place them directly on the rack of your oven.
  2. Step 2
    Place a piece of foil on the rack below to reduce mess.
  3. Step 3
    Bake the sweet potatoes for 45-50 minutes or until tender. Times may vary depending on how hot your oven gets.
  4. Step 4
    Remove the potatoes from the oven and let stand at room temperature until they are cool enough to handle, about 20-30 minutes. Leave the oven on.While your potatoes are cooling, melt the butter over medium heat. Continue to cook the butter, stirring frequently, until brown bits begin to form on the bottom of the pan, about 5-6 minutes. Pay close attention as the butter can quickly go from brown to burnt in a matter of seconds. Once you see the brown bits forming and a nutty aroma fills the air, pull the butter from the heat immediately. Set aside.
  5. Step 5
    Cut the tops off of the sweet potatoes, lengthwise. Scoop the sweet potato flesh into a medium bowl, leaving the skins in tact. To the bowl, add the brown butter, 2 tablespoons of the fresh parsley, 3/4 of the chopped bacon, and 4 ounces of the goats cheese.
  6. Step 6
    Sprinkle with salt and black pepper to taste and mash the ingredients together until combined. Scoop the filling back into the sweet potatoes.
  7. Step 7
    Place the potatoes on a baking sheet that has been lined with foil or parchment paper.
  8. Step 8
    Place them back in the oven to bake for 25 minutes.While your potatoes are baking for a second time, prepare your avocado cream. In the bowl of your food processor or blender, combine the avocados, sour cream and buttermilk.
  9. Step 9
    Add a dash of salt and pepper and pulse until completely smooth and creamy.Once your potatoes have baked, remove from oven.
  10. Step 10
    Sprinkle on the remaining parsley, bacon and goats cheese.
  11. Step 11
    Drizzle with avocado cream and serve immediately.Enjoy!I hope you enjoy this recipe for brown butter twice baked sweet potatoes!

Ingredients (11)

  • 1 lb baby dutch potatoes 1 pound baby Dutch potatoes
  • 1 lb green beans 1 pound green beans
  • 15 oz canned tomatoes 1 15-ounce can petite diced tomatoes
  • 3 lbs chicken breasts 2 pounds chicken breasts; hall portion
  • 3 lemons 2.5 lemons
  • 8 cloves garlic 8 cloves garlic (4 minced, and 4 sliced)
  • 4 oz feta cheese 4 ounces feta cheese
  • 1 large onion 1 large onion
  • 2 tsp salt and pepper 2 teaspoons salt and pepper
  • 2 tbsp oregano 2 tablespoons fresh oregano
  • 2 tbsp parsley 2 tablespoons fresh parsley

Steps (5)

  1. Step 1
    Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
  2. Step 2
    Cut each chicken breast into 4-5 even-sized strips.In a large bowl add the chicken pieces, lemon juice from one whole lemon, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 teaspoon salt, pepper, and paprika, and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
  3. Step 3
    Mix together well and set bowl aside while you prepare the veggies.Rinse beans, snip off the end with the hard nub/stem, and place them in another large bowl. The other end should have a dainty little tail that is soft and thin and doesn't need to be removed.Chop one large yellow onion and add to the beans.Rinse (and scrub if needed) the baby potatoes and add to the veggie bowl.Stir in one 15-ounce can of petite diced tomatoes, juice from half a lemon, oregano, parsley, 1 teaspoon of salt and pepper, and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
  4. Step 4
    Pour the mixture onto a large baking sheet (you may want to line it with parchment paper or tin foil), add the chicken pieces (spaced evenly throughout the pan), some lemon slices, 4 thinly sliced garlic cloves, about a dozen pitted Kalamata olives, and roast at 450 degrees for 20 minutes.Pull the pan out from the oven but don't remove. Crumble 4 ounces of feta cheese and sprinkle onto the sheet pan and continue to cook for 5 more minutes, or until the chicken reads 165 degrees with a meat thermometer.
  5. Step 5
    Serve while it's hot and garnish with chopped parsley.
